items.stem: An agent graph can revisit a node repeatedly with no condition to stop. What must you add?

options.text: A termination guard or step limit so the loop ends
options.rationale: Correct: an unbounded loop must have an explicit termination condition.

options.text: A faster model so the loop finishes sooner
options.rationale: Speed does not stop an infinite loop; it just loops faster.

options.text: More memory to hold the growing state
options.rationale: More memory postpones but does not prevent the runaway.

options.text: A retry on each node to improve reliability
options.rationale: Retries add more iterations, worsening the loop.

items.explanation: Correct: an unbounded loop must have an explicit termination condition.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO properties make persisted agent state safe to resume? (Select TWO.)

options.text: State is durably written so a restart can resume it
options.rationale: Correct: durable persistence is what allows resumption after failure.

options.text: Replayed steps are idempotent and do not duplicate actions
options.rationale: Correct: idempotency prevents a resumed step from acting twice.

options.text: State is held only in process memory for speed
options.rationale: In-memory-only state is lost on restart.

options.text: Each resume starts the task from the beginning
options.rationale: Restarting from scratch defeats the purpose of persisted state.

items.explanation: Correct: durable persistence is what allows resumption after failure.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: What is the simplest safeguard against a runaway agent consuming unbounded cost?

options.text: A hard cap on steps and spend per run
options.rationale: Correct: explicit caps contain a misbehaving agent.

options.text: Trusting the model to stop when appropriate
options.rationale: The model cannot be relied on to self-limit cost.

options.text: Monitoring the bill at the end of the month
options.rationale: After-the-fact monitoring does not prevent the overrun.

options.text: Using a cheaper model with no other limit
options.rationale: A cheaper model still runs away without a cap.

items.explanation: Correct: explicit caps contain a misbehaving agent.
